sanskrit_verse:
वर्षासु न विषं दद्यात् हेमन्ते नाप्सु मज्जयेत् ।
न लोहं हारयेद् ग्रीष्मे न कोशं पाययेन् निशि ॥
transliteration: varṣāsu na viṣaṃ dadyāt hemante nāpsu majjayet | na lohaṃ hārayed grīṣme na kośaṃ pāyayen niśi ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In the rainy season, no poison shall be given; in winter, one shall not immerse in water; in summer, no iron shall be worn; at night, no shell (intoxicant) shall be consumed.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with natural rhythms
Causation arises through disruption of seasonal dharmic conduct
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by environmental harmony
Restoration logic requires synchronization with cosmic order
Consciousness alignment occurs when actions align with temporal dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF season = Varsha AND action = administer_poison THEN permit = false
IF season = Hemanta AND action = full-body immersion in water THEN permit = false
IF season = Grishma AND action = wearing iron THEN permit = false
IF time_of_day = night AND substance = intoxicating shell THEN permit = false
IF action violates seasonal dharma THEN initiate consciousness realignment protocol
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, violation of temporal-dharmic injunctions constitutes a failure of consciousness alignment. The threshold of responsibility is not intent but disruption of universal rhythm. Authority lies in restoring synchronicity, not assigning blame.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that imbalance originates from misalignment with natural law. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that such acts sequentially disturb individual and collective consciousness. Responsibility is proportional to one’s capacity to sustain harmony. Non-punitive reality is upheld as suffering is not causal to correction—awareness is.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Assign completion process aligned with violated element (e.g., water, fire, earth, air)
Implement consciousness recalibration through rhythmic practices
Reintegrate individual into temporal dharmic cycle via guided observance
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law is declared: Dharma is restored through alignment with natural time. There is no punishment, only realignment. Consciousness is the ultimate judge.
